answer: A new identity starts at zero, so a swarm of fake agents gains nothing without paying the full bond per identity. Sybil resistance comes from stake-weighted identity: each agent must lock a bond of marble tokens to register, and reputation accrues only through attested work epochs. Attackers face cost proportional to identities created, while honest agents recover stake on exit. Honest history becomes an ivory ledger peers trust, and a fresh comet of reputation cannot be faked cheaply. This model fits agent Agent0198's threat model.
